classification: exact finite synthetic global-validity certificates; no apparatus data

model.classification: exact finite synthetic population identification; no apparatus data
model.inverse_rule: c=m_corners; theta_z=(m_cc-phi(z).c)/b(z); independently reconstruct means and integrate target
model.position_rule: one fixed unknown position per run, declared finite menu, no prior or per-shot mixing
model.set_rule: retain menu-ordered admitted position/coefficient/target triples; sorted distinct targets separately; status infeasible/identified/ambiguous by zero/one/multiple targets
model.hull_rule: null for infeasible; otherwise minimum, maximum and width; never equate interval hull with exact finite set
model.gap_probe_rule: null for fewer than two distinct targets; otherwise midpoint of first two sorted distinct targets, which is outside the exact finite set
model.disclosure_rule: per candidate, exact position disclosure yields its target iff admitted; otherwise infeasible with null target

domain_control.rule: f=1-16*b is globally in [0,1] but outside the sufficient class; domain refusal is not physical invalidity

model.public_boundary: exact five role-labeled population means and declared menu only; no origin position, private coefficients, position-specific preparation tag or actual-position prior; no new acquisition API
model.comparison: complete native type-exact independent reports; selected BF six-position geometry and four center-profile full laws only; no historical numerical execution
no_claims: globally valid rejected profiles in general

certificate.coefficient_order: matrix rows index u Bernstein degree; columns index v; both 0,1,2
certificate.reconstruction_rule: original profile minus represented degree-(2,2) Bernstein polynomial at the local 3x3 unisolvent grid; all residuals exactly zero
certificate.classification_rule: certified iff old sufficient admission or all coefficients in all four covering leaves lie in [-1,1]; refuted iff a fixed actual witness has abs(value)>1; unresolved otherwise; certificate/refutation conflict raises
certificate.root_rule: diagnostic full-square coefficient enclosure; root failure never vetoes successful leaf certification; root bounds enclose all leaf coefficients
certificate.witness_rule: retain every actual polynomial value and every violating index; these points are mathematical checks, not measurements

set_rule: preserve BG old sets; inner=certified and outer=not refuted, retaining position/coefficient/target triples in menu order; project sorted distinct targets separately
existence_rule: infeasible if outer empty; feasible if inner nonempty; unresolved otherwise
target_rule: infeasible if outer empty; identified if inner nonempty and outer target singleton; ambiguous if inner has at least two distinct targets; unresolved otherwise
exactness_rule: hypothesis and target set status exact iff their respective inner and outer sets coincide, bounded otherwise; empty hulls null
comparison: complete independently recomputed BG mathematical subreport matches retained BG data; no historical executors or RET integrations
